opening.argument: The DoorDash offer is presented as a specific referral promotion, with credit conditioned on signup and a qualifying first order rather than as an unexplained promise. The app screen states that seven dollars in credits are provided when someone signs up through the referral link and places a first order over twelve dollars. The speaker explains copying and reposting the link so viewers can click it, and describes the result as DoorDash credits. Although the title uses broader language about free food and unlimited credit, the visible offer supplies concrete conditions and a defined promotional benefit. The evidence therefore supports ordinary referral commerce and rewards, without establishing a deceptive mechanism.
